children: XCF Global amended its Business Combination Agreement with DevvStream and Southern Energy, reshaping post-merger ownership and removing several closing hurdles. The amendment sets expected post-close stakes at about 69.57% for existing XCF holders, ~20% for former Southern holders, and ~10.43% for former DevvStream holders, and deletes minimum cash, investment bank, revenue/EBITDA, foreign listing, and HSR clearance conditions. Effectiveness is tied to a concurrent $1 million GL warrant investment, and EEME and GL outlined post-closing funding plans targeting at least $4.373 million plus a Shortfall Amount within three months and commercially reasonable efforts toward an additional $50 million within 12 months.
